emergent.why: `plan.py::_bill_invoice_evidence` asks 'is this a bill email?', which cannot be checked, so it leaks — observed false positives on Verizon, Xfinity and Eversource. Tightening must not starve charge matching, which needs the card alerts the invoice gate currently rejects.

emergent.summary: Detect unmodelled recurring charges by starting from the CHARGE, not a sender filter (OS-069)
emergent.why: An enumerated filter must know the answer in advance, which is why 28 bill-like senders had no coverage. A recurrence pass over the ledger found 'fruitful membership' at $48/mo that no email keyword had surfaced. Proposes only; never auto-creates a commitment.

emergent.summary: Trial watch — surface a converting trial before it charges (OS-070)
emergent.why: Owner-stated intent ('we are building a free trial canceler'). The ledger already holds a converted trial: Unifyed.ai Trial -39.99. Depends on V4's suppression lifecycle or it becomes the alert storm V4 is gated on.

emergent.summary: 18 legacy evidence links from the retired amount-only matcher are demonstrably wrong
emergent.why: A $9.99 marketing email is linked to charges 55/59/84, and one charge has the same receipt linked three times. NOT removed: absence is recorded, never deleted (C01), so removal needs explicit owner approval. Harmless today, will confuse any future display that trusts links.

emergent.summary: The calendar connector remains wired to nothing (the outstanding part of OS-067)
emergent.why: Referenced only for its OAuth scope constant while a stored token sits unused. This is the third of the three things the owner originally reported and the only one still open; it sits on the critical path in a way the earmarked ideas do not.

emergent.summary: The 729 content-less evidence rows are NOT recoverable and must not be re-proposed
emergent.why: Owner decision 'Leave it' (commit c8d6d69). Historical metadata-only loss; the Gmail originals are unrecoverable because the tokens are dead, and the only partial recovery re-reads the personal iCloud INBOX, reopening the privacy tradeoff the Bills folder closed.

emergent.summary: A harness-mediated Gmail ingestion service is possible but NOT built
emergent.why: D-016 keeps it available: the app cannot call Composio today, but a scheduled agent-driven sweep is architecturally legitimate. Not authorised by D-016 and would need its own decision, operational footprint, and honest liveness statement. Meridian must keep working without it.
